parsed.summary: The PR introduces a more accurate check for namespace packages, but it may inadvertently affect other packages without a __file__ attribute.

issues.description: The change assumes that any package without a __file__ and a non-list __path__ is a namespace package, which may not be true for other types of packages.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that the change does not break existing behavior or introduce new issues.
